subject: website
name: Orivon latest release
summary: The folder that always holds Orivon's newest release, judged here by its own publisher. Its start page is a few lines of plain HTML and an unminified inline script, written by orivon-mvp's release pinner (scripts/pin-releases.sh), so it is its own public source. It picks the package for the visitor's system and starts that download from the same folder; it contacts nothing else and runs no third-party code. Every file is content-addressed, so Orivon checks each package against the address. Each new release moves the name to a new folder, which is judged again when it appears.

operations.name: Download the package for your system
operations.note: The package is a file of the same folder, checked against its address.
